scenarios.description: Deep supplier disruption stress test (PDF §1: an 8-week inbound delay — the mean of U{5..10} — at the top-impact supplier, starting 1–3 weeks after steady-state onset). The engine warm-starts inventories at S_m, so its steady state begins ≈ week 10 (vs week 85 in the paper's cold-start implementation); the PDF's t* = 86 (t_w + 1) is therefore expressed as week 12 here, inside the 52-week KPI analysis window.
